title: The Handler That Outlived Its Item: Connections Made Twice, and in Items That Are Gone

questions.question: The same slot is connected to a signal three times. How many calls for one emit?
What does connect_once return the second time?
options: false: the connection exists, and nothing was made

questions.question: A QML item connects with signal.connect(function) and is later destroyed. What happens when the signal fires?
options: The handler still runs, and throws because its names went with the item
questions.explanation: 3 warnings from 3 items that were gone, each a ReferenceError.

questions.question: What does a Connections element do differently?
options: It is part of its item
questions.explanation: The connection ends with it. The same reloads gave 0 warnings.

questions.question: Why can connect_once not recognise a lambda connection?
options: A lambda is a new function each time
questions.explanation: There is nothing to compare. It works for member function pointers.

questions.question: A lambda is connected with a receiver, and the receiver is deleted. What happens?
options: The lambda is called on a dead object
The connection ends with the receiver
questions.explanation: One more signal made no call.
